commit_subject: fix(import): a PDF of an Executive or Timeline résumé imports each job's company, role and location in their own fields (R2-148-c)
commit_body:
Re-lands 95afab8 (reverted in f2da8ef) without its regression on the Sidebar's education.

Cause: Executive prints a job inline ('Role, Company' as one line with the date at its right, the location alone at the right margin under the date): the import read that location as the company and 'Role, Company' as the role. The Timeline prints the date above the title, 'Role ⇥ Company' side by side under it and the location under that: the import found each job by its date but gave it no company or role, and both went into its description.

Fix, as 95afab8: pdfLinesOfPages (src/utils/importFile.js) marks a line that is one field alone at a block's right margin with hint 'end'. In src/utils/importText.js, readHeader reads such a line under the title as the location; a tab on the line right under a date alone no longer marks a location; a lone 'Role, Company' of a job is split at the comma that has a job title's word on one side only (inlinePair), so 'Acme, Inc.' and 'Portland, OR' stay whole; and a date alone on its line with no title line before it takes the line under it as its title, plus the one under that when it holds two fields or a place (the Timeline's rail).

The regression (gate 36221038666, 99-import-roundtrip-columns, sidebar): 95afab8 also read a place alone on its line as the location whenever two text fields came before it in the header, in any section. The Sidebar's side column stacks a school's degree, school, field of study and place a line each over its dates, so 'Seattle, WA' became the location in readHeader, entryOf's education rule never saw the place among its fields, and the field of study it pairs with that place ('Computer Science', the one field left over) went into the description. Now that rule is what the Timeline needs and no more: only for a job (experience, volunteering), and only right under a line that held both the role and the company ('Role ⇥ Company' side by side, 'Role — Company' or 'Role, Company' inline): fields stacked a line each never count. The Sidebar's school reads as before.

Test: tests/unit/import-pdf-entry-layouts.unit.mjs builds pdf.js items for Executive, Timeline (Side by side, Inline, Inline with an italic sub) and Classic (control) and reads them back, plus the Sidebar's stacked school (degree, school, field, place, dates) which must keep its field of study and place; tests/pdf/99-import-roundtrip-entry-layouts.test.mjs renders Classic, Executive and Timeline with the app's react-pdf code and reads them back with pdf.js. tests/pdf/99-import-roundtrip-columns.test.mjs (Sidebar and Compact) guards the regression.
notes: Confirmed at d11d5a0: importFile.js/importText.js are byte-for-byte the pre-95afab8 state (f2da8ef reverted it), so Executive jobs still read the location as the company and Timeline jobs lose company/role into the description. Cause of the revert, traced by hand: the earlier patch's lone-place rule in readHeader was `titled >= 2 && PLACE.test(p) && !ROLE.test(p)` for every PLACED type. SideEducation (src/templates/pdf/shared/PdfSidebarColumn.jsx) prints degree / institution / fieldOfStudy / location / dates a line each; entriesOf pulls the four lines over the lone date into the header; at 'Seattle, WA' two parts (B.S., Lakeside University) are above, so readHeader took it as h.location; entryOf's education branch then had location set, placeAt = -1, and the `placeAt >= 0 && left.length === 1` rule that turns the leftover 'Computer Science' into fieldOfStudy did not fire, so it went to description. Fix: the lone-place rule now needs JOB.has(type) (experience, volunteering) and `above >= 2`, the count of text fields the line right above gave when it had a tab (the Timeline's 'Role ⇥ Company'); everything else of the earlier patch is unchanged, including its tests. The 'end' hint cannot fire in the Sidebar's side column (every line there starts at the column's left edge, and the hint needs a start past the block's middle). Product call: a place alone under two stacked (non-tab) job fields stays a text field, as before R2-148-c, rather than guessing it is the location. The new Sidebar-education unit case passes at base too (it is the regression guard, in the same file as the fail-first Executive/Timeline cases, which fail at base). Nothing was run locally (owner's rule). No docs/knowledge line describes these layouts' import. Not covered (unchanged from the earlier notes): Executive's inline Education run still reads as one institution field; a right-hand sidebar column is still read after the main one. Review round 1 (reviewer's change, in the patch): the fixer's rule counted the line above only when it had a tab, which left the Timeline's Title 'Inline' ('Role — Company' / 'Role, Company' over the location, and ItemHeader's centred Inline) filing the location into the description, and with an italic sub reading 'Role, Company' as the role and the place as the company. `above` is now the number of fields the line right above gave (a job's lone 'Role, Company' counted as two via inlinePair), so any one-line role-and-company counts and fields stacked one per line (the Sidebar) still never do; two unit cases for Timeline Inline and Inline-italic added (they fail at base: no title at all). Known limits, product call to leave: a one-word location with no region ('Berlin') under a Timeline title is not a PLACE, so it stays in the description; a Timeline custom entry's location still joins its subtitle.
reviewed: Round 1: bug real at d11d5a0 (importFile/importText = pre-95afab8); traced revert cause (cumulative titled>=2 took the Sidebar school's 'Seattle, WA' so entryOf's placeAt rule never set fieldOfStudy) and that the new rule leaves it to entryOf; hand-traced every unit case through pdfPageBlocks/pdfPageLines/pdfLinesOfPages/entriesOf/readHeader (Executive/Timeline fail at base, pass with fix; Sidebar case fails on 95afab8, passes now); checked hint 'end' is ignored by resumeFromText/tests that map lines to text, Timeline/Executive defaults (sidebyside / inline+italic), columns/one-column/import-text tests unaffected; widened the Timeline rule to Inline variants with two new unit cases; patch git-apply --check clean on d11d5a0.
